decisions.reason: The accelerator program sits far from the firm's machinery core and has shown no quantified results, but it is cheap to run and still featured on the home page, so a growing firm with slack is likely to carry it for another year.
The bio-based bitumen binder still has its own page and fits the circular-materials vision, and its uncertain early results are tolerable given the firm's expansion and R&D slack, so it stays.
The infectious waste plant is promoted on the home page as a flagship partnership with ERMAFA and is close to the core offer, so it appears to meet aspirations and calls for no problemistic search.
